searchLedger.hypothesis: The exclude-based split can drop a file when the heavy file is renamed

searchActions.result: the first process names the file explicitly, so a rename yields no matching test and a non-zero exit

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Union of the two processes is the whole project, and a rename fails loudly
searchLedger.rationale: The split cannot silently drop a file
